metadata.title: Yuzu – Relieve Desk Pain in 5 Min | Personalized Stretching App
metadata.description: Yuzu is the personalized stretching app to relieve pain from sitting at a desk all day. 5-minute routines, no equipment needed, guided by a fun mascot. Available on the App Store.

hero.title: Back pain from your desk?
hero.subtitle: Yuzu offers ultra-quick, personalized stretching routines to relieve pain from sitting all day. No equipment, no gym clothes, right from your desk.

painPoints.title: 8 hours sitting takes its toll
painPoints.subtitle: Desk work and remote work force you into prolonged postures that create chronic pain. Sound familiar?

neck.title: Stiff neck
neck.description: Cervical tension from staring at a screen all day long.

back.title: Back pain
back.description: Lower back pain that builds up after hours of sitting without moving.

shoulders.title: Tense shoulders
shoulders.description: Stiffness and knots in your shoulders from poor posture.

painPoints.transition: The good news? Just 5 minutes a day can change everything.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: 3 simple steps to regain your mobility

step1.title: Pick your pain zone
step1.description: Neck, back, shoulders… Tell Yuzu where it hurts, it handles the rest.

step2.title: Follow your 5-min routine
step2.description: Step-by-step stretches guided by your favorite mascot. Doable at your desk, in pajamas, anywhere.

step3.title: Regain your mobility
step3.description: End your day pain-free and gain flexibility day after day.

features.title: Why Yuzu is different
features.subtitle: An app built for people who don't have time (or desire) to hit the gym

quick.title: 5 minutes flat
quick.description: Ultra-quick routines that fit into any schedule. No need to block an hour.

noEquipment.title: Zero equipment needed
noEquipment.description: Doable at your desk, at home, in pajamas. No gym clothes required.

personalized.title: 100% personalized
personalized.description: Select your pain zone and get a session tailored to your specific needs.

fun.title: Guided by Yuzu
fun.description: An energetic lemon mascot that motivates you without pressure. Goodbye guilt.

mascot.title: Meet Yuzu
mascot.subtitle: Your pocket wellness coach
mascot.description: Yuzu is an energetic little lemon that guides you through every stretch. Always encouraging, never guilt-tripping. It walks you through each movement so you can regain your mobility at your own pace.

appStoreCta.title: Ready to say goodbye to desk pain?
appStoreCta.subtitle: Download Yuzu for free and start your first 5-minute routine right now.

footer.description: Yuzu is the personalized stretching app to relieve pain from desk work. Made in France by Yuzu Labs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Yuzu Labs is committed to protecting the privacy of users of its application and website. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data.

collection.title: Data Collected
collection.content: We collect the following data: account information (email, name), application usage data, user preferences, and exercise progress data.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.content: Your data is used to: personalize your experience, improve our services, send you notifications about your progress, and provide customer support.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: Our website uses essential cookies for the service to function and analytical cookies to improve the user experience. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.content: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, delete and port your data. To exercise these rights, contact us at yuzu.contactme@gmail.com.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: Your data is kept for the duration of your use of the service and up to 3 years after your last activity, unless otherwise required by law.

contact.title: DPO Contact
contact.content: For any questions regarding the protection of your data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer at: yuzu.contactme@gmail.com

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms of use govern access to and use of the Yuzu application and the yuzulabs.app website.

object.title: Purpose of the Service
object.content: Yuzu is a wellness application offering personalized stretching routines to relieve pain from desk work and remote work.

access.title: Access to the Service
access.content: Access to the application requires creating a user account. The user agrees to provide accurate information and to maintain the confidentiality of their credentials.
